gaps.sentence: We found ___ that the flight had been cancelled.
The new manager wants to back ___ the sales team's proposal.
gaps.explanation: back up = support (a person, plan); also make a copy of data.

gaps.sentence: Sales figures have tailed ___ since the summer.
The store decided to branch ___ into online sales.
gaps.explanation: branch out = start doing something new and different.

gaps.sentence: We're trying to get rid ___ these old boxes.
gaps.explanation: get rid OF something = remove it.

gaps.sentence: The plane will drop ___ the parcels at the next farm.
gaps.explanation: drop off = deliver somebody/something; also become less (sales dropped off).

gaps.sentence: She always gets round ___ washing up by promising to do it later.
gaps.explanation: get round to = finally find time for; here: avoid a duty — test the preposition after get round.

gaps.sentence: I can't figure ___ how this app works.
